mapper.sql: select calculation_id, tenant_id, dept_id, room_type_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, num_adults, num_children, channel_code, member_level, advance_booking_days, base_price, final_price, total_discount, applied_rules, calculation_context, calculation_time, calculation_source, order_id, is_final_booking, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from pms_pricing_calculations
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(check_in_date) as date, AVG(final_price) as avg_price, MIN(final_price) as min_price, MAX(final_price) as max_price, COUNT(*) as calculation_count FROM pms_pricing_calculations WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND check_in_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(check_in_date) ORDER BY DATE(check_in_date)

SELECT DATE(calculation_time) as date, COUNT(*) as usage_count, AVG(total_discount) as avg_discount, SUM(total_discount) as total_discount_amount, AVG(final_price) as avg_final_price FROM pms_pricing_calculations WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND calculation_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND JSON_SEARCH(applied_rules, 'one', #{ruleId}, NULL, '$[*].ruleId') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE(calculation_time) ORDER BY DATE(calculation_time)

SELECT DATE(check_in_date) as date, SUM(final_price * DATEDIFF(check_out_date, check_in_date)) as total_revenue, SUM(base_price * DATEDIFF(check_out_date, check_in_date)) as base_revenue, SUM(total_discount * DATEDIFF(check_out_date, check_in_date)) as total_discount_amount, COUNT(*) as booking_count, AVG(final_price) as avg_price FROM pms_pricing_calculations WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND check_in_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND is_final_booking = 1 GROUP BY DATE(check_in_date) ORDER BY DATE(check_in_date)

SELECT CASE WHEN final_price < 100 THEN '0-100' WHEN final_price < 200 THEN '100-200' WHEN final_price < 300 THEN '200-300' WHEN final_price < 500 THEN '300-500' WHEN final_price < 800 THEN '500-800' ELSE '800+' END as price_range, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_pricing_calculations WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND check_in_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}), 2) as percentage FROM pms_pricing_calculations WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND check_in_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY CASE WHEN final_price < 100 THEN '0-100' WHEN final_price < 200 THEN '100-200' WHEN final_price < 300 THEN '200-300' WHEN final_price < 500 THEN '300-500' WHEN final_price < 800 THEN '500-800' ELSE '800+' END ORDER BY MIN(final_price)

SELECT channel_code, COUNT(*) as booking_count, AVG(final_price) as avg_price, MIN(final_price) as min_price, MAX(final_price) as max_price, AVG(total_discount) as avg_discount, SUM(final_price * DATEDIFF(check_out_date, check_in_date)) as total_revenue FROM pms_pricing_calculations WHERE del_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND check_in_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND channel_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY channel_code ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
